analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 42.2 remains in neutral territory, a slight rise from 37.5 five days ago but not a strong oversold exit signal. MACD histogram is improving (-1.4389 → 0.0960) but still negative. ADX at 23.3 indicates an early trend formation stage, with -DI (31.9) outweighing +DI (20.5). A Higher Low pattern is forming with the 5-day low ($353.70) above the 20-day low ($342.33). Volume ratio is subdued at 0.61. Overall, a lack of directional conviction and trend formation warrants a wait-and-see approach.
